name: EDCI 5865
title: Multicultural Education in the Content Areas
description: This seminar course explores equity and justice in schools and society. In particular, we focus on multicultural education in the content areas as a way to understand the interrelationships between students’ identities and cultures, their schooling experiences, and their content learning.
requirement_description: Enrollment in the Teacher Certification Program for College Graduates and successful completion of summer semester courses.
